welcome.descrizione: I love building engaging and interactive web experiences with modern technologies such as React and Angular.

presentazione.infoPersonali:
I work at the intersection of design and development, defining clear and scalable patterns.
I design accessible, responsive components that stay true to the brand.
I optimise rendering and bundles to maximise speed and perceived quality.
I collaborate with designers and stakeholders to align goals and outcomes.
Goal: fast, consistent interfaces that are genuinely easy to use.
presentazione.occupazionePresente: I currently work as a Frontend developer at JDK.srl, a consultancy based in Rome (IT), building and maintaining modern, responsive user interfaces that respect Figma designs, accessibility standards and best practices to deliver a high-quality, performant product.
presentazione.spareTime: In my free time I love exploring—whether that's new technologies, landscapes, cultures or flavours. Anything new is worth exploring and inspires the future, especially when I share it with my partner. I enjoy listening to music and working out to keep both mind and body healthy.
